#                                                                                                                                                                                                       

# Dig to Escape

**Grab your shovel and get digging!**  

Dig to Escape is a stylized VR prison-break game where you dig, survive, and outsmart the mole to escape.

[media]
**Dig for upgrades**

Mine valuable minerals and sell them to upgrade your tools. Better gear means faster digging, deeper tunnels, and more escape options.


[media]
**Watch out for the mole**

A sneaky thief is after your loot. Catch him before he makes off with your hard-earned minerals!



[media]
**Be the inmate boss**

Brawl, intimidate, or outsmart other inmates. Take on optional quests that can help your escape—or make things much more dangerous.
